title: First humanoid robot surgeon performs live surgery
excerpt: We visit UCSD's Center for the Future of Surgery to see how humanoid robots are taking on live surgical procedures.
content_html:
We visited UCSD's Center for the Future of Surgery to learn about the first ever live surgery using humanoid robots.
